subject: Greenfield Logistics — PO issuance request & onboarding materials
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@greenfieldlogistics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PO request & vendor onboarding — Greenfield Logistics

Hi Marcus / Connor,

Thanks for the quick reply on the onboarding form earlier this week. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for inference consumption across our logistics product suite. To get procurement moving on our side I need a provisional PO (or PO number) and confirmation of the initial spend cap so I can schedule our first invoices.

Background: we'll be invoicing for two items in the first month — "Model Inference (per-token)" and "Dedicated Support Hours". Estimate for month one is $34,500 (tokens) + $12,500 (support) = $47,000. Our AP team requires a dedicated PO number and line-item breakdown to book the invoice.

Attached: onboarding_form_filled.pdf (completed), W9_Greenfield.pdf

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can issue a provisional PO number for onboarding?
- If spend caps are required on your end, can we set an initial $50,000 cap and then review after first billing?
- Any additional vendor paperwork you need from us?

Appreciate it — we want to avoid delaying the first invoice.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of Procurement
Greenfield Logistics
[Attachment: onboarding_form_filled.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: W9_Greenfield.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@greenfieldlogistics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO request & vendor onboarding — Greenfield Logistics

Emily — thanks for the materials and the clear numbers. Welcome aboard.

Quick next steps from our side:
- I attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf to show the required fields; looks like you completed most items. Two small asks: a billing contact email (if different from you) and your preferred remittance instructions.
- We can allocate a provisional PO number immediately for AP to reference. Finance prefers to keep provisional spend caps aligned to estimated first-month spend; $50,000 is fine as an initial envelope.
- For the line items: Finance sometimes prefers SKU-level mapping. Can you confirm whether Greenfield will send one combined invoice or separate invoices per SKU (tokens vs support)? Your note suggests combined; if combined, we'll still map internally to two ledger lines to preserve cost reporting.

I've looped in Connor (Finance) and Laura (Onboarding) to handle the PO issuance and the final SKU/line-item mapping. Connor — can you draft PO and assign the final PO id and PHI/PCI restrictions if applicable? Laura — onboarding intake and access provisioning once PO is issued.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Emily Park <emily.park@greenfieldlogistics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO request & vendor onboarding — Greenfield Logistics

Thanks Marcus — attaching the remittance instructions and confirmed billing contact: ap-invoices@greenfieldlogistics.com. Greenfield will submit one combined invoice per month from our ERP; line items within the invoice include the two ledger codes you mentioned (INF-TOKENS, INF-SUPPORT).

Forwarding the completed onboarding form and W-9 again for your records. Apologies — our supplier output flattens to a single total amount but we include SKU-level rows in the invoice line section.

On the SKU mapping: could your finance team confirm the internal ledger names you prefer? If you can provide the PO number and confirm the initial spend cap allocation per SKU we will finalize our internal purchase request.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Procurement
Greenfield Logistics

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@greenfieldlogistics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0400
Subject: PO issued: PO-2026-8227 — Greenfield Logistics (spend allocation & line-item corrections)

Emily / Marcus / Laura,

Thanks for the patience. Finance has issued the formal PO for Greenfield: PO-2026-8227 (attached PDF). Items below summarize the ledger mapping and spend envelope:

- PO number: PO-2026-8227
- Total authorized envelope (initial): $50,000 (provisional)
- Month-one estimate held: $47,000 (no action required)

Line-item mapping (please reference these exact ledger codes on your invoice lines):
1) INF-TOKENS — SKU: RD-INF-TOKENS — allocated cap: $35,000
2) INF-SUPPORT — SKU: RD-INF-SUPPORT — allocated cap: $15,000

Note: We split the spend envelope conservatively to provide headroom for token usage spikes. If Greenfield prefers a different split, we can reallocate within the PO before the first invoice date; please flag by COB Mon Aug 16.

Corrections and instructions: 
- The onboarding form used your internal SKU labels; our AP system requires the Redwood SKU codes listed above. If your invoice line uses INF-TOKENS / INF-SUPPORT, please include parentheses with the Redwood SKU (e.g., INF-TOKENS (RD-INF-TOKENS)).
- Please email invoices to ap-invoices@redwood.com and cc ap-ops@redwood.com. Net 30 terms apply unless a Net-45 was pre-agreed (we have none on file).
- Attachment: PO-2026-8227.pdf (formal PO). I also included a DocuSign link for acceptance if you want an executed copy: https://docusign.com/links/abc123-po

Laura — please start the access provisioning (API keys + initial model quotas) once Emily confirms the invoice format and the final split.

Emily — if everything looks good I can mark the PO as fully active and you can submit your first invoice against PO-2026-8227.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO-2026-8227.pdf (PDF)]
